_comment: Sample Scripted REST provisioner for the Graph Entity Service connector (design §6). The connector-specific settings (objectTypes, pageSizeDefault, byIdLookup, deleteMissingTolerated, apiKeyHeader, connectTimeoutMs, socketTimeoutMs) travel in customConfiguration as a Groovy ConfigSlurper script and surface to the scripts via configuration.propertyBag. objectTypes is a JSON string. byIdLookup is 'get' (GET /admin/entities/{id}) or 'search' (an EQUALS filter on the ID, decision P21) while GET by ID is unreliable (C1). Authentication (decision P13): the service takes one shared API key, sent raw in the X-API-KEY header. Put the key in 'password', which IDM encrypts on write; leave 'username' empty and 'defaultAuthMethod' NONE so IDM adds no Basic header. connectTimeoutMs (default 10000) and socketTimeoutMs (default 60000) bound every request, so a stalled service cannot hang reconciliation. The connector library is deployed as graphentity-connector-lib.jar (./gradlew :connector:connectorScripts): IDM 7.5 fails to compile it from Groovy sources on the classpath the first time (WS7.02).
name: graphentity

configurationProperties.password: CHANGE-ME: the service's X-API-KEY value. IDM encrypts it on write.
configurationProperties.customConfiguration: pageSizeDefault=200; byIdLookup='get'; deleteMissingTolerated=true; rePutOnDroppedEdges=false; apiKeyHeader='X-API-KEY'; connectTimeoutMs=10000; socketTimeoutMs=60000; objectTypes='{"user":{"idmResource":"managed/user","entityKind":"subject","idProperty":"userName","attributes":["name","mail","telephoneNumber"],"archetypes":["Customer"],"archetypeProperty":null,"relationships":{"owns":{"remoteType":"Owns","direction":"outbound","relatedType":"account","reverseProperty":"ownedBy"}}},"account":{"idmResource":"managed/account","entityKind":"resource","idProperty":"accountId","attributes":["name","productCode"],"archetypes":["Account"],"relationships":{"ownedBy":{"remoteType":"Owns","direction":"inbound","relatedType":"user","reverseProperty":"owns"}}}}'

objectTypes._comment: Generated, not hand-written: POST this provisioner to system?_action=createFullConfig and save the result once, which carries the object types from the Schema script. IDM does not fill this in by itself; left empty, system/graphentity/<type> does not exist and reconciliation fails. Call createFullConfig before saving: saving first initialises the connector twice at once, which can fail on the first call with a LinkageError (found in IDM 7.5, WS8).
